content: NativeWind stable is 4.2.7; v5 is PRE-RELEASE only. Requires tailwindcss ^3.4.17 (Tailwind v4 NOT supported in v4). Expo setup: babel-preset-expo with jsxImportSource nativewind + nativewind/babel preset, withNativeWind metro wrapper, global.css import, works with reanimated 4 + worklets on SDK 57.
